reviews.comment: She was quite an amiable professor and she always provided helpful feedback whenever asked. Lecture information and lab instructions were clear and concise and tests were manageable. Just don't wait until the last minute to begin a lab report or study for a test.

Historical Archaeology was interesting and the projects we did were sometimes even fun. I've only taken a few classes in Anthropology, but this one was easily my favorite. Kennedy was always willing to help and work with her students to improve their work.

Dr Kennedy is great! Wasn't sure on this class, but I enjoyed it so much. Genealogy Project, Transcription Project, Term Paper and 2 Exams. If this is one you're on the fence, take it. She is available outside of class and clearly passionate about what she does. Grading is fair and great feedback.

reviews.comment: Prof Kennedy is funny, sweet and very Canadian. This class is not hard, but it's not an easy A. I nearly made a B from underestimating her exams. If you skip lectures for this class, you will not pass. She is also very helpful outside of class. I emailed her a question once for a different course and she gave me a detailed answer within the day.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: I didn't really enjoy anthropology itself, but professor Kennedy was amazing! The lectures got a little boring, but everything you need to know is on the slides. There were pop quizzes but they were pretty easy. The tests weren't bad either. She gave us lots of extra credit assignments. Would definitely take her again.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Kennedy was a great prof! Lectures are in class only so you have to go to class and take notes. Beware of random pop quizzes! She was a really nice prof and her test were super easy! If you need extra credit she will definitely hand you some. If I could take her again I would!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Kennedy truly cares about her students! She provides many opportunities to earn extra credit at the end of the semester. Be sure to attend class to get notes and take possible pop quizzes! Tests are sooooo easy. Highly recommend!!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: She has great lectures and is knowledgeable and passionate about what shes teaching. As long as you don't get on her bad side, she's very helpful and understanding. She can be pretty sarcastic. You HAVE to go to class to do well on the tests! The pop quizzes are easy 100s if you take good notes and do the readings.

reviews.comment: Professor Kennedy is a very nice lady who works hard to make this class as easy as possible. Sometimes she tries to force her views on you, but other than that a great prof! If you need to take ANTH 205, take Professor Kennedy! Grades are based on three non-cumulative tests, 10 pop quizzes and 1 two-page article review.

reviews.comment: Overall, great prof. Very knowledgeable and fun. If you go to class and take notes, it should be an easy class. The only major assignment is an article review. You don't have to read the textbook but I use it to study for exams. Also, she is willing to work with you if you have to miss class.
